description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
